generics.chinaRebateWithdrawal: China withdrew export tax rebates on certain chemicals from 1-Apr-2026; Divi's says the effect is on raw materials, not on competing APIs; 78% of its procurement by quantity is now domestic

westAsia.effects: Solvent prices 'almost double or triple'; ammonia and methanol supply tight; force majeure by suppliers; freight and container shortages; the rupee at record lows (~95-97 per US dollar in May-Jun 2026, ~86-88 a year earlier)
westAsia.src: Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 calls; ThePrint / Scroll rupee reports (May-Jun 2026)

biosecure.item: US Senate passed the BIOSECURE Act (Dec-2025), restricting US federal business with certain Chinese biotech suppliers; Macquarie called Divi's the front-runner in capacity creation to benefit

tariffs.item: Section 232 (2-Apr-2026): 100% tariff on patented drugs and their APIs from 31-Jul / 29-Sep-2026; 15% cap for EU, Japan and Switzerland; 0-20% for companies with US onshoring and pricing deals; generics exempt. Divi's sells mostly to European and Japanese innovators (Europe 61% of FY26 revenue, North America 13%), whose products enter the US at the capped rates, so the direct hit is small; the risk is pressure on innovators to localise supply.

street.methodNote: Brokers that disclose a method mostly use P/E on forward EPS (Motilal Oswal 55x 12M forward, BOBCAPS 56x Mar-28E, JPMorgan 55x Mar-28E at initiation, Sharekhan 51x and Choice 50x FY28E in earlier notes; PL quotes P/E). JM Financial, HDFC Securities and Macquarie use EV/EBITDA; HDFC translates its 39x into 56.5x P/E. With negligible debt and cash ~1.4% of market value, the two are nearly the same yardstick.

moat.factor: Process chemistry and cost in generic APIs
moat.evidence: World's largest maker of 10 key APIs; 60-70% share in several; backward integration (Kakinada) kept share despite two years of price erosion
12 of the top 20 pharma companies, many for 10-25 years; 18-20 projects commercial or being commercialised; customers pre-pay capacity (Rs1,207 cr of advances in FY26)
Clean USFDA outcomes since the 2017 Unit 2 import alert was lifted; Units 1 and 2 inspected in FY25-26
Divi's sits in customers' CMC filings; changing supplier needs re-validation and agency approval, but only for the life of each molecule
~18,600 KL of reactor capacity; claims to build capacity in ~18 months vs 3-4 years in the West
Integrated from protected amino acids to fragments, several 3,000-litre SPPS lines; no disclosed commercial GLP-1 revenue yet
Generic API value growth ~0-7% a year while volumes grow; recent price rises only pass through solvent costs (CEO, Aug-2026)
No customer or product disclosure beyond BRSR (valsartan 5.0%, naproxen 5.0%, levetiracetam 3.2% of FY26 standalone turnover)

critiques: Valuation already discounts the pipeline: 83x trailing EPS, and our Sep-28E target multiple is still ~60x
Motilal Oswal (Neutral, 55x), ICICI Securities (Sell), Kotak (Sell, May-2026)
Q1FY27 gross margin (68%) was flattered by a ~Rs500 cr inventory build; adjusted margin closer to 28-30%
IIFL (on the Q1FY27 call), PL ('inventory gains'), HDFC Securities ('GM to normalize')
Much of the growth is the rupee: constant-currency growth was 6.8% in FY26 and ~10% in Q1FY27 vs 12.8% and 27.8% reported
Company disclosures; JM Financial (Q4FY26 call question)
Capex runs ahead of revenue: FY26 capex 24% of sales vs a 13% history; gross asset turn ~1.2x; timing of the dedicated projects depends on customers
Goldman Sachs and JM Financial (Q4FY26 call), Kotak ('high capex intensity')
Generic API prices keep falling; Chinese competition and late-life-cycle custom products (valsartan/sacubitril) shrink
BofA (Q2FY26 call), Goldman Sachs (Q1FY26 call); valsartan share 6.4% to 5.0%
Promoter pay is very high: Rs224 cr to executive directors in FY26, ~6.5% of standalone PBT; MD at 1,692x the median employee
Working capital is heavy and rising: inventory Rs4,413 cr at Jun-26 (~346 days of material cost in FY26)
Little disclosure: no product, customer, capacity or order-book figures (CDAs)
gaps: Molnupiravir and other Covid-product revenue in FY21-23 is not disclosed by the company; only press/broker estimates (Rs392 cr FY22 estimate).
Customers, molecules, prices and peak revenue of the three dedicated projects are confidential; we model them only through custom-synthesis growth.
The April-2024 contract filing itself was not reviewed; its Jan-2027 timeline is as recalled on the Q4FY26 call.
Peptide capacity (litres, number of SPPS lines) and any GLP-1 revenue are undisclosed; product links (enlicitide, icotrokinra, GLP-1 fragments) are Citi's, not the company's.
Named institutional holders at Jun-2026 (>1%) not retrieved; named promoter holdings are from the AR at Mar-2026.

Valuation methods not found for Citi, Jefferies, Morgan Stanley, ICICI Securities, DRChoksey and Systematix; Kotak, Goldman Sachs and BofA post-Q1 targets could not be dated before 30-Sep-2026 and are left out.
Business Standard and Baroda eTrade (BOBCAPS) pages block automated access; their content is taken from search summaries only.
Average USD/INR and EUR/INR rates by quarter were not sourced; the currency effect is taken from the company's constant-currency disclosures.
Whether any Divi's custom-synthesis product falls under the Section 232 patented-API tariff, and at what rate, is not disclosed.
Q2FY26 and Q3FY25 constant-currency growth and Q2-Q4FY25 forex figures were not recorded in the transcripts we read.
conflicts: Q4FY25 call: 54% for the year. But the four quarterly disclosures (Q1 49%, H1 51%, 9M 52%, Q4 51%) imply ~51.5%, which is also PL's figure. We use 51.5% (custom synthesis Rs4,820 cr), so FY26 custom-synthesis growth is +20.5%.
Revenue from operations Rs3,080 cr (Screener, PL, HSIE) vs total income Rs3,144 cr (company release, incl. other income). We use Rs3,080 cr.

Transcript: EBITDA margin 'would be the similar as last year'. PL: 'OPM to remain in line with FY26'. HDFC Securities: 'higher EBITDA margin in FY27'. We read the transcript literally and give partial credit for currency.

Corporate governance report and Board's report (signed 23-May-2026): Dr. Ramesh B. V. Nimmagadda is Chairman. Related-party note lists K. V. Chowdary as 'Independent Director and Chairman'. We use the governance report.
Industry export data showed API prices up in June-2026 (Goldman Sachs on the call); the CEO says this is only solvent cost pass-through, not a market recovery.
